title: Ventspils Castle
scope: The restored Livonian Order Castle at Ventspils, including its four wings, southeast tower, courtyard skylight and adjoining mapped heritage wall.
limitations: The current museum exterior, chapel and characteristic tower follow the historic quadrangle and original Qualla view. A number of small openings and rear facade details are estimated.
The current glazed cover is represented by an unobtrusive modeled roof. The courtyard interior and its collection are outside the exterior scope.
